remarks: Welcome to 34 B Foxberry Drive. This second floor two-bedroom, one bathroom condo is bright and clean and has an appealing open layout. The large living room has medium oak laminate flooring and a sliding glass door to a south-facing balcony with a canvas awning. The kitchen has plenty of Formica counters and wood cabinets and the appliances are included (electric stove, refrigerator and dishwasher.) There is an adjacent dining area which is also a good spot to create an office area. Both bedrooms are good sized with large closets and are carpeted.  There is a storage unit on the first floor, and a common laundry room shared with the other owners in the building. The furnace was replaced in 2022, and the air conditioning unit was replaced in 2021. The hot water and water are included in the monthly Homeowners' Association fee of $228 as well as all exterior landscaping, plowing and maintenance. The HOA replaced the roof in 2017.  Convenient location close to UB Amherst Campus and the 990 and 290 expressways. Enjoy the community pool, low taxes and association fees and the ease of living here at Foxberry.
